headline: McClatchy cut local journalists across its newspapers last month while investing in AI-generated content, Tech Policy Press reports.
score_reason: Kept at the pool score: detailed reporting on a large newspaper chain shifting from reporters to AI content, with union and staff sources.
importance_line: Readers in many US cities lose local reporters, including some covering city hall, while AI content grows; the article is critical in tone and McClatchy did not respond to requests for comment.
summary: Tech Policy Press reports that McClatchy, owner of about 30 US newspapers, laid off staff last month, including at least 90 unionised journalists and media workers, while expanding AI content tools such as a "Content Scaling Agent" that summarises staff articles. McClatchy has not cited financial trouble for the cuts, and a spokesperson did not respond to the outlet.
notes: Exact layoff date not stated in the article ("last month").
